judged_text: The review iteration silently removed the development-mode admin bypass: the old code skipped the host check when `Rails.env.development? && current_user.try(:admin?)`, but the new code raises Discourse::InvalidAccess unconditionally unless the referer matches an EmbeddableHost row. A developer running a local Discourse in development mode as admin can no longer test embedding from any referer; embed pages now 403/redirect until they manually insert an EmbeddableHost row for their local hostname — a behavior regression nobody accepted in review.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does not remove the development-mode admin bypass. In `app/controllers/embed_controller.rb` the guard `if !(Rails.env.development? && current_user.try(:admin?))` is still present, so in development while logged in as admin the host check is still skipped. The change only swaps the underlying host-allow check from `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?(request.referer)` (and a blank-setting check) to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` for non-dev/admin requests.
